# Audit report — classify all ~499 test files

## Goal
Run a comprehensive review of every `*.test.ts` file in the suite (499 files at commit f601fb4, ~145k lines), classify each against the anti-pattern taxonomy, produce `docs/dev/test-suite-review.md`, and create child work items for each removal/clean-up group.

## Acceptance Criteria
1. **Complete classification table** — Every file is classified as `keep` / `remove` / `clean-up` with evidence (file path, line count, category, observed pattern, rationale).
2. **Inventory reconciles** — The report's per-category counts sum to the total file count (499 at audit commit). The report records the audit commit hash.
3. **Removal/clean-up list** — Each proposed removal has file path, line count, category, and rationale.
4. **Report committed** — `docs/dev/test-suite-review.md` exists in the repo diff.
5. **Removal recommendation children created** — For each removal/clean-up group, create a child work item under CG-0MTCOPO8U001UW2Y with `wl create --parent CG-0MTCOPO8U001UW2Y --issue-type task --priority low --stage idea --title "Test review: remove <group>" --description "…" --json`. Each child has a clear goal + measurable ACs. **No test file is deleted by this child — only recommendations are created.**

## Anti-pattern taxonomy (from CG-0MS9AGG3N003ASCR)
- **source-code-grep**: assert the text of source files (readFileSync + toContain/string index on .ts files), break on any refactor, never detect behavioral regressions
- **placeholder/tautological**: `expect(true).toBe(true)` with no real assertion
- **self-referential simulations**: import zero production code, test only their own structure
- **duplicates of core coverage**: test something already tested by a deeper core-engine test
- **type-level/structural-only**: assert factory returns N fields the compiler already enforces
- **zero-assertion browser tests**: browser tests with no `expect()` calls

## Known candidates (pre-scan)
- `tests/main-street/MainStreetApplicant.test.ts` (721 lines, 30 expect(true).toBe(true) placeholder branches — functions now exist, guards may be dead code)
- `tests/helpers/main-street-tutorial-cleanup.browser.test.ts` (1 expect(true).toBe(true) defensive guard)
- `tests/core-engine/ChallengeSystem.test.ts` — source-grep on ChallengeSystem.ts
- `tests/core-engine/SaveLoad.test.ts` — source-grep on SaveLoad.ts
- `tests/core-engine/DifficultyPresets.test.ts` — source-grep on DifficultyPresets.ts
- `tests/core-engine/no-runtime-synthesis.test.ts` — reads .ts source files

## Notes
- Asset integrity tests (readFileSync on JSON manifests, SVG icons) are NOT source-grep — they verify data files, not source code. Keep these.
- Browser tests that boot Phaser scenes and check rendered elements are genuine UI tests.
- When in doubt, classify as `keep` with a `needs-manual-verification` note.
- Removal children are created as siblings of this child, under CG-0MTCOPO8U001UW2Y.
data.title: Run full audit and produce test-suite-review report

# Author .pi/skills/test-review/SKILL.md

## Goal
Create a repo-local skill at `.pi/skills/test-review/SKILL.md` that codifies the test-suite review methodology, making the audit reproducible on demand.

## Acceptance Criteria
1. **Skill file exists** — `.pi/skills/test-review/SKILL.md` with front-matter (`name` + `description`) and markdown body following the project skill convention (precedent: `.pi/skills/release-windows/SKILL.md`).
2. **Methodology documented** — Anti-pattern categories listed with definitions and detection patterns.
3. **Discovery commands documented** — Exact grep/find patterns for each category:
   - Placeholder: `grep -rl 'expect(true)\.toBe(true)' tests --include='*.test.ts'`
   - Source-grep: `grep -rln 'readFileSync.*\.ts.*utf-8' tests --include='*.test.ts'`
   - Zero-assertion: `find tests -name '*.test.ts' -print0 | xargs -0 grep -L 'expect('`
   - Self-referential: check imports for zero production code references
   - Duplicates: compare test scope against core-engine test scope
4. **Classification steps** — Step-by-step procedure for classifying each file.
5. **Report format** — Document the expected output format (classification table, per-category counts, rationale).
6. **Child-work-item creation convention** — How to create `wl create --parent <id> --issue-type task` entries for each removal group.
7. **Skill exercised** — Run the skill's documented procedure on a subset of files (e.g., all files with `expect(true).toBe(true)`) to verify the procedure works end-to-end.

## Notes
- The skill should be written so a future agent can re-run the audit on a clean checkout by following the documented procedure.
- The skill is a **procedure document**, not an executable script — it codifies the methodology for future use.
data.title: Author reproducible test-review skill

# Goal
Remove the fully vacuous `tests/main-street/MainStreetApplicant.test.ts` (721 lines).

# Why
Audit recommendation R1 (`docs/dev/test-suite-review.md` §4). The file's 23 tests all gate on an `engineExport()` helper that probes `require('../../example-games/main-street/MainStreetEngine')`; under Vitest ESM the `require` throws `Cannot find module`, so every branch falls back to one of its 30 `expect(true).toBe(true)` tautologies — **zero real assertions execute**, even though the four functions under test (`resolveStaffApplicant`, `hireStaffApplicant`, `declineStaffApplicant`, `letGoStaffMember`) now exist in `MainStreetEngine.ts`.

# Acceptance criteria
- `tests/main-street/MainStreetApplicant.test.ts` is deleted.
- `grep -rl "MainStreetApplicant" tests src example-games` finds no remaining references to the file's exports.
- `npx vitest run --project unit tests/main-street/` is green after removal.

# Out of scope
The applicant-trigger specification has value and should be re-implemented later with static ESM imports as a **separate** work item — do not rewrite it here. Report: `docs/dev/test-suite-review.md` R1.
data.title: Test review: remove tests/main-street/MainStreetApplicant.test.ts (vacuous placeholder)

# Goal
Remove `tests/scripts/dev-server-cleanup.test.ts` (222 lines).

# Why
Audit recommendation R2 (`docs/dev/test-suite-review.md` §4). The file defines its own `createLockFile`/`removeLockFileDirectly` helpers and asserts on those — it imports **zero** production code and never touches `scripts/dev-server-utils.ts`, so it is a self-referential simulation that cannot catch a regression in the real lock-file/cleanup logic. The real functions are already exercised by `tests/scripts/dev-server-utils.test.ts` (imports the actual module).

# Acceptance criteria
- `tests/scripts/dev-server-cleanup.test.ts` is deleted.
- `npx vitest run --project unit tests/scripts/` is green after removal (real coverage retained in `dev-server-utils.test.ts`).
- No other file imports from the deleted test.

Report: `docs/dev/test-suite-review.md` R2.

# Goal
Replace the source-grep test in `tests/main-street/sold-card-tooltip.test.ts` (reads `MainStreetRenderer.ts` text) with a behavioural test that calls the tooltip builder and asserts the returned string.

# Why
Audit recommendation C3 (`docs/dev/test-suite-review.md` §5). The regression guard matters (CG-0MTFS4PP40064GHE: a sold card still provides synergy to adjacent businesses), but asserting source text breaks on any refactor. Importing the tooltip-producing function directly preserves the guard and asserts observable behaviour.

# Acceptance criteria
- No `readFileSync` of `MainStreetRenderer.ts` in the test.
- The test invokes the actual tooltip function and asserts the sold-card string states it still provides synergy to adjacent businesses (and does not claim income-or-synergy stops).
- `npx vitest run --project unit tests/main-street/sold-card-tooltip.test.ts` is green.
- If the tooltip string is produced inline in the renderer without a callable function, extract it to an importable helper (minimal refactor) and note the assumption.
data.title: Test review: convert sold-card-tooltip.test.ts to a behavioural test

# Goal
In `tests/main-street/market-card-cheat.test.ts`, replace the test that reads `scenes/MainStreetScene.ts` source text with a behavioural assertion of the same invariant.

# Why
Audit recommendation C4 (`docs/dev/test-suite-review.md` §5). The current test asserts the file text contains `import.meta.env.DEV` and `createMarketCardCheatTool` — a tree-shake guard with real intent but a source-grep mechanism.

# Acceptance criteria
- The `readFileSync` of `MainStreetScene.ts` is gone; the invariant (dev-only gating of the cheat tool) is asserted through the public API — e.g. the cheat tool is not registered/activatable in a non-DEV mode, or via the module's registered tools list.
- All other tests in the file still pass (`npx vitest run --project unit tests/main-street/market-card-cheat.test.ts`).
- Assumptions documented if a production-code change is needed to expose the invariant.
data.title: Test review: convert market-card-cheat tree-shake grep test to a behavioural check

# Goal
Stop `tests/main-street/help-panel-content.test.ts` testing a local copy: extract the Help/Rules panel content now defined inline in `MainStreetLifecycleManager.ts` (L326) into a shared, Phaser-free module imported by both the scene and the test.

# Why
Audit recommendation C5 (`docs/dev/test-suite-review.md` §5). The test mirrors the content and asserts on its own copy, importing zero production code — it can silently drift from the real help text, giving false assurance.

# Acceptance criteria
- A Phaser-free module (e.g. `example-games/main-street/MainStreetHelpContent.ts`) exports the help sections; `MainStreetLifecycleManager.initHelpPanel` uses it.
- `tests/main-street/help-panel-content.test.ts` imports the production module and asserts headings, order, English-only, and `<= 8` line counts against it (no local content copy).
- `npx vitest run --project unit tests/main-street/help-panel-content.test.ts` is green.
- Behavioural copy change in the scene's help output matches the module (browser smoke covers rendering).
data.title: Test review: extract Main Street help content to a Phaser-free module (help-panel-content.test.ts)

# Goal
Remove the compile-time-only helpers and literal-shape assertions from `tests/rule-engine/LegalityResult.test.ts`, keeping the real behavioural tests.

# Why
Audit recommendation C7 (`docs/dev/test-suite-review.md` §5). The `_assertLegal`/`_assertIllegal`/`_assertNarrowing`/`_assertHelper*` functions are `void`-ed and duplicate what the TypeScript compiler already checks; several `it()` blocks assert on hand-built object literals rather than production output.

# Acceptance criteria
- The `void`-ed `_assert*` helpers are removed.
- `it()` blocks that only assert hand-built literal shapes are removed or converted to assert `legalAction()`/`illegalAction()` output.
- `npx vitest run --project unit tests/rule-engine/LegalityResult.test.ts` is green (the dynamic-import `legalAction`/`illegalAction` and rule-engine-version tests remain).

data.description:
## Goal

Provide the test-first foundation for the runtime game plugin loader: a synthetic, loadable game artifact plus `games/manifest.json` variants, so every loader feature (parser, version compatibility, dynamic import, asset resolution, selector merge) can be unit-tested without a real game repo or a packaged Electron app.

## Context

Part of FEATURE: Electron runtime game plugin loader (CG-0MTRO7VMI000F3A5). No Vite library-mode game artifact exists yet, so tests need a hand-authored fixture that mimics the artifact contract:

```
tests/fixtures/plugin-game/
  manifest.json            # valid entry
  entry.js                 # ESM module exporting a fixture Scene class + GAME_INFO
  assets/thumbnail.png     # tiny deterministic PNG
```

## Acceptance Criteria

- A synthetic ESM game artifact fixture exists under `tests/fixtures/` exporting a Phaser-compatible scene class and a `GAME_INFO` object, importable from a Vitest (Node) context.
- At least five manifest variants are committed: valid, missing file, malformed JSON, incompatible `coreEngineVersion`, duplicate `id`/`sceneKey`.
- A shared test helper exposes the fixture paths and a `makeManifest(...)` builder so tests do not hand-roll JSON.
- The fixture PNG is a deterministic, tiny (<1 KB) valid image with a documented provenance (generated/CC0), respecting the project asset-licensing policy.
- Fixtures are excluded from production builds and do not alter existing test profiles.

## Minimal Implementation

- Add `tests/fixtures/plugin-game/` with `entry.js`, `assets/thumbnail.png`, and manifest variants.
- Add `tests/fixtures/plugin-game/helpers.ts` (paths + `makeManifest`).
- Document the fixture's role in a short header comment.

## Key Files

- `tests/fixtures/plugin-game/entry.js`
- `tests/fixtures/plugin-game/manifest.json`
- `tests/fixtures/plugin-game/assets/thumbnail.png`
- `tests/fixtures/plugin-game/helpers.ts`

## Dependencies

None.
data.title: Loader test harness & fixture
